main.note: lexical, approximate alignment; unlocalized claims count in no sentence

citations.definition: valid = quote is an exact substring of the cited passage and start/end offsets reproduce it; wrong_passage_index = the quote exists only in another passage

raw_citations.definition: as-given valid = the raw citation was an exact passage quote with the right index; repaired (normalized/fuzzy/relocated) and dropped citations count as invalid. downgraded_claims = claims forced to UNSUPPORTED for lack of a valid citation
